items.criterion: The first saved moment moves a logbook from the empty state to draft.
items.judgment: The logbook state changes on the first save.
items.evidence: The logbook read back after one save.

items.criterion: An order write rewrites every entry position from the submitted list index.
items.judgment: Positions match the order the diver submitted.
items.evidence: The entries read back after one order write.

items.criterion: A reordered logbook returns the diver's own order to a fresh read.
items.judgment: A second client reads the order the first one wrote.
items.evidence: The entries read back through a new session client.

items.criterion: Publishing a draft moves the logbook to published and writes the publish instant.
items.judgment: The state and the instant both change on a passing publish.
items.evidence: The logbook returned by the publish path.

items.criterion: Republishing a withdrawn logbook returns the very same public identifier.
items.judgment: The identifier after a republish equals the identifier before the withdrawal.
items.evidence: The logbook returned by the second publish.

items.criterion: Marking a logbook answered writes the answered instant.
items.judgment: The state and the instant both change when the owner answers.
items.evidence: The logbook returned by the dock answer path.

items.criterion: Removing an entry closes the gap in the remaining positions.
items.judgment: Positions stay contiguous from zero after a removal.
items.evidence: The entries read back after one removal.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous order writes resolve to one whole list rather than interleaving.
items.judgment: The stored order equals one of the two submitted lists.
items.evidence: The entries read back after two racing writes.

items.criterion: A minted public identifier carries the pinned entropy floor in a URL-safe alphabet.
items.judgment: The identifier is long enough and safe to put in an address.
items.evidence: The identifier returned by the publish path.

items.criterion: A thirteenth saved moment is refused as a full logbook.
items.judgment: The ceiling holds and the entry count is unchanged.
items.evidence: The entries read back after a refused save.

items.criterion: A logbook outside the draft state refuses every mutating write.
items.judgment: Every write against a published logbook answers a conflict.
items.evidence: The entries read back after five refused writes.

items.criterion: The public logbook read serves a browser holding no session at all.
items.judgment: The published logbook answers without a cookie.
items.evidence: The public read made with a cookieless client.

items.criterion: A host asking for a draft logbook is answered as a missing record.
items.judgment: The owner's request for a draft answers not found.
items.evidence: The dock read for a draft logbook identifier.

items.criterion: The public address of an unpublished logbook answers not found.
items.judgment: A withdrawn address stops answering at once.
items.evidence: The public read after a withdrawal.

items.criterion: A hostile note reaches the public read as text rather than as markup.
items.judgment: The characters the diver typed come back escaped in the page.
items.evidence: The public logbook page carrying the hostile note.

items.criterion: Publishing delivers the live message to the publishing diver with the public address inside.
items.judgment: The delivered message names the address the feature exists to hand over.
items.evidence: The message waiting in the inbox for the publishing diver.

items.criterion: A reset request for an unregistered address delivers no message at all.
items.judgment: The inbox for an unknown address stays empty.
items.evidence: The inbox count for an address that has no account.

items.criterion: Signing out revokes every session the account holds.
items.judgment: A second tab loses its session when the first signs out.
items.evidence: The logbook read from a second client after a sign out.

items.criterion: The page view record accrues a row for every public route that is served.
items.judgment: The total moves by the number of routes served.
items.evidence: The page view total read by the portfolio owner.

items.criterion: Every public route carries a title no other route shares.
items.judgment: No two routes carry one title.
items.evidence: The document head of every public route.
